Subject: FinTechCo discovery — follow-up & proposed next steps

Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call + suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: FinTechCo is evaluating a hosted/dedicated inference deployment for real-time transaction risk scoring (peak 2k TPS, typical latency target ~50–100ms p95). Primary concerns are data residency (US-only), predictable latency, and integration with your existing Kafka event stream.

- Proposed pilot: 2-week Rapid POC on Redwood Dedicated (small GPU pool) to validate end-to-end latency and throughput with a subset of live traffic + an implementation plan for go-live. Goals: validate p95 latency, KV cache behavior, and cost estimate for production.

- Next steps (suggested):
  1) Confirm that a 2-week POC is of interest and who the technical point of contact on your side will be (Priya?).
  2) Block 60–90 minutes for a technical deep-dive with Ben (our SE) to align on integration points and perf testing plan.
  3) Review attached discovery notes and the SOW draft; I can tighten scope after Ben’s deep-dive.

Attachments: 20260515-FinTechCo-discovery-notes.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.docx

Alex — can you share availability next week for the deep-dive? If helpful, we can do a short pre-read call first. I’ll hold a couple of windows Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Alex — great questions. Quick answers inline: 

1) Data residency: For the Dedicated pilot we can either provision in Redwood-managed infra in a US-only region or work with your AWS account (VPC peering/PrivateLink). For the POC lane it's usually faster to start in our managed environment and then migrate the infra plan to a customer VPC for production — but if you need the pilot in your account for compliance we can coordinate.

2) Pricing: Ballpark — for a small Dedicated pool sized to handle ~2k TPS peaks we expect $Xk–$Yk/month (depends on sustained usage and autoscaling policy). I can get a more detailed estimate after Ben and I size the pool from your perf targets. If it helps, we can offer a pilot credit to cover the 2-week POC while we validate perf.

3) Integration: Ben — can we cover Kafka integration and batching patterns in the deep-dive?

Ben / Monica — looping you both for technical and onboarding context. Ben I propose Wed 21 May 2:30–3:30pm PT for the deep-dive; LMK if that works. Monica — if we proceed with a short POC I’d love a rough success plan we can share.

Thanks —
Marissa
